## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 360 captures during October 2018. Capture activity was completed at the site throughout the reporting month, with the total providing the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below. The activity figure reflects the number of captures submitted for review during the period.

## Image quality

Image quality was assessed for the captures received from Market Eye Clinic. A total of 12 captures were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.3 per cent. The ungradable images could not be used for grading and are included in the reported total for the month. The result provides the overall measure of image suitability for October 2018.

## Grading

Grading identified 49 referable results from the captures reviewed. The median lag between capture and grading was 2 days. This measure summarises the time taken for images to progress from capture to completion of grading during October 2018. Together, the referable result count and the median lag describe the grading activity recorded for Market Eye Clinic in the reporting month.
